notes: The board's certification of a question voted on in several counties, as the county with the most voters in it, listed with its results on its page (https://boe.cuyahogacounty.gov/elections/GetElectionById/258/); each county's figures are as it printed them.

The Cuyahoga County Board of Elections's own file, listed under the general election on its page (https://boe.cuyahogacounty.gov/elections/GetElectionById/258/); fetched once and kept in states_cache/oh_local/results/20241105/cuyahoga/. The board's server pads the file with zero bytes after its end; they are set aside.

The Franklin County Board of Elections's own file, listed under the general election on its page (https://vote.franklincountyohio.gov/election-info/2024); fetched once and kept in states_cache/oh_local/results/20241105/franklin/.

The Secretary's own file address answers scripts with a Cloudflare challenge, so the workbook was read from the Internet Archive's capture of that address taken 2024-12-07 (https://web.archive.org/web/20241207004035id_/https://www.ohiosos.gov/globalassets/elections/2024/gen/official/statewide-race-summary.xlsx), saved on 2026-10-02 and read here from disk; the SHA-256 is the saved file's. Marked 'Official Canvass' in its own title row.
gaps: The Secretary of State publishes statewide issues in a workbook of their own, which is not saved on this computer; the Secretary's site turns scripts away, so it has to be saved from a browser.
